tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

Also note the "使用建议" says modify D column and 分类汇总 recalculates — but 分类汇总 values are static constants (computed in Python), not formulas. That's misleading! The 分类汇总 sheet contains constant numbers, so changing D won't update it.

Two options: (a) make 分类汇总 use formulas (COUNTIF/MINIFS/MAXIFS/AVERAGEIF) so it auto-updates; (b) reword 说明.

Better: use formulas — more professional and consistent with the claim. But MINIFS/MAXIFS require Excel 2019+; AVERAGEIF is older. Safer: use MIN(IF()) array? That needs CSE in old Excel. Alternative: SUMPRODUCT-based MIN/MAX which works everywhere:
- 菜品数: =COUNTIF(菜单明细!$B$5:$B$109,A4)
- 最低价: =MIN(IF(...)) → skip; use =SUMPRODUCT(MIN(IF(...)))? messy.

Simplest robust approach: keep static numbers, and reword 使用建议 to reflect reality: "价格如有调整，可自行修改“菜单明细”D 列；“分类汇总”为本次整理的静态统计结果，需同步更新".

Alternative min/max formula that works without CSE: 
最低价: =MIN(IF(...)) no. Use =SMALL(IF(...)) no.
There is: =AGGREGATE(15,6,prices/(cat=A4),1) — AGGREGATE with option 6 ignores errors, works in Excel 2010+. And =AGGREGATE(14,6,prices/(cat=A4),1) for max. AGGREGATE is supported in Excel 2010+ and WPS. This handles arrays natively without CSE.

E: =AGGREGATE(14,6,...,1)

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""核对重算后的工作簿：公式结果、结构、样式是否与预期一致。"""
import openpyxl

P = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\bingge\recalc.xlsx'

wbv = openpyxl.load_workbook(P, data_only=True)
wbf = openpyxl.load_workbook(P, data_only=False)

exp = {
    '家常小炒类': (18, 15, 30, 20.611111),
    '碳烤青菜类': (25, 2, 15, 3.8),
    '锡纸类': (4, 7, 20, 14.25),
    '碳烤荤菜': (36, 2, 35, 6.611111),
    '碳烤海鲜类': (12, 3, 118, 22.0),
    '碳烤把串类': (10, 7, 15, 13.9),
}

s_v = wbv['分类汇总']
s_f = wbf['分类汇总']
ok = True
for r in range(4, 10):
    name = s_f.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    vals = [s_v.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6)]
    cnt, share, mn, mx, av = vals
    e = exp[name]
    good = (
        cnt == e[0]
        and abs(share - e[0] / 105) < 1e-9
        and mn == e[1] and mx == e[2]
        and abs(av - e[3]) < 1e-4

content.arguments:
{"command": "$py = 'C:\Users\24380\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'
$wd = 'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\bingge'
$node = 'C:\Users\24380\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe'
$cli = 'C:\Users\24380\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\libreoffice-kit\lib\cli.js'
& $py "$wd\merge_menu.py" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
Remove-Item -LiteralPath "$wd\merged_out.xlsx" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $node $cli recalculate --input "$wd\merged.xlsx" --output "$wd\merged_out.xlsx"

Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path $parent -Filter *.png | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }", "description": "Rebuild merged file and render three sheets"}

    w = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)['菜单明细']
    out = {}
    for i in range(1, w.max_row + 1):
        n = w.cell(row=i, column=3).value
        p = w.cell(row=i, column=4).value

for x in rows:

print('价差/来源校验:', 'OK' if not bad else bad)

# 合计行
tot = None
for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
    if ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value == '合计':
        tot = [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 10)]
print('合计行:', tot[:8])

# 汇总页
ws2 = wb['分类汇总']
for r in range(4, ws2.max_row + 1):
    vals = [ws2.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 8)]
    if vals[0]:
        print('汇总:', vals)
print('sheets:', wb.sheetnames)

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""核对合并表：行数、去重、价格与来源一致、公式结果、菜名口径。"""
import openpyxl

BASE = r'C:\Users\24380\Downloads\烧烤\兵哥烧烤菜单'
MERGED = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\bingge\merged_out.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(MERGED, data_only=True)
ws = wb['合并对照表']

rows = []
for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
    no = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    if not isinstance(no, int):
        continue
    rows.append({
        'cat': ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value,
        'name': ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value,
        'b': ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value,
        'l': ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value,
        'o': ws.cell(row=r, column=6).value,
        'd': ws.cell(row=r, column=7).value,
        'src': ws.cell(row=r, column=8).value,
        'note': ws.cell(row=r, column=9).value,
    })


def src_items(path):
    w = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)['菜单明细']
    out = {}
    for i in range(1, w.max_row + 1):
        n = w.cell(row=i, column=3).value
        p = w.cell(row=i, column=4).value
        if not n or not isinstance(p, (int, float)) or '个菜品' in str(n):
            continue
        out[n] = float(p)
    return out


bg = src_items(BASE + r'\兵哥烧烤_菜品价格表.xlsx')
lh = src_items(BASE + r'\林火序菜单_菜品价格表.xlsx')

print('合并行数:', len(rows))
print('兵哥原表:', len(bg), ' 林火序原表:', len(lh))
print('来源分布:', {s: sum(1 for x in rows if x['src'] == s) for s in ('两家均有', '仅兵哥烧烤', '仅林火序')})

b_sum = round(sum(x['b'] for x in rows if x['b'] is not None), 2)
l_sum = round(sum(x['l'] for x in rows if x['l'] is not None), 2)
print('兵哥价格合计:', b_sum, 'vs 原表', round(sum(bg.values()), 2),
      'OK' if abs(b_sum - sum(bg.values())) < 0.001 else 'MISMATCH')
print('林火序价格合计:', l_sum, 'vs 原表', round(sum(lh.values()), 2),
      'OK' if abs(l_sum - sum(lh.values())) < 0.001 else 'MISMATCH')
print('条数一致:', sum(1 for x in rows if x['b'] is not None) == len(bg),
      sum(1 for x in rows if x['l'] is not None) == len(lh))

names = [x['name'] for x in rows]
print('菜名唯一:', len(names) == len(set(names)))

# 菜名口径：两家都有的行，名称必须来自林火序原表
bad_names = [x['name'] for x in rows if x['src'] == '两家均有' and x['name'] not in lh]
print('两家均有行的菜名均取自林火序:', 'OK' if not bad_names else bad_names)
only_l_bad = [x['name'] for x in rows if x['src'] == '仅林火序' and x['name'] not in lh]
print('仅林火序行菜名在源表:', 'OK' if not only_l_bad else only_l_bad)
only_b_bad = [x['name'] for x in rows if x['src'] == '仅兵哥烧烤' and x['name'] not in bg]
print('仅兵哥行菜名在源表:', 'OK' if not only_b_bad else only_b_bad)

# 兵哥原始菜名是否都能在备注里找到对应（两家均有且改名者）
missing_note = []
for x in rows:
    if x['src'] != '两家均有':
        continue
    if x['note'] and x['note'].startswith('兵哥名'):
        continue
    # 备注不以“兵哥名”开头 → 说明兵哥叫法与林火序相同，应在兵哥表里存在同名
    if x['name'] not in bg:
        missing_note.append(x['name'])
print('改名行均有“兵哥名”备注:', 'OK' if not missing_note else missing_note)

bad = []
for x in rows:
    if x['d'] is not None and abs((x['l'] - x['b']) - x['d']) > 0.001:
        bad.append((x['name'], x['b'], x['l'], x['d']))
    if x['src'] == '两家均有' and (x['b'] is None or x['l'] is None):
        bad.append(('来源标记与价格不符', x['name']))
    if x['src'] == '仅兵哥烧烤' and (x['b'] is None or x['l'] is not None):
        bad.append(('仅兵哥标记不符', x['name']))
    if x['src'] == '仅林火序' and (x['l'] is None or x['b'] is not None):
        bad.append(('仅林火序标记不符', x['name']))
print('价差/来源校验:', 'OK' if not bad else bad)

for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
    if ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value == '合计':
        print('合计行:', [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 10)][:8])

ws2 = wb['分类汇总']
for r in range(4, ws2.max_row + 1):
    vals = [ws2.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 8)]
    if vals[0]:
        print('汇总:', vals)
print('sheets:', wb.sheetnames)

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""核对加了「兵哥×130%」列后的合并表。"""
import openpyxl

BASE = r'C:\Users\24380\Downloads\烧烤\兵哥烧烤菜单'
MERGED = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\bingge\merged_out.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(MERGED, data_only=True)
ws = wb['合并对照表']

print('表头:', [ws.cell(row=4, column=c).value for c in range(1, 11)])
rows = []
for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
    if not isinstance(ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value, int):
        continue
    rows.append({
        'name': ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value,
        'b': ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value,
        'b130': ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value,
        'l': ws.cell(row=r, column=6).value,
        'd': ws.cell(row=r, column=8).value,
        'src': ws.cell(row=r, column=9).value,
    })

print('行数:', len(rows))

bad = []
for x in rows:
    if x['b'] is None:
        if x['b130'] not in (None, ''):
            bad.append(('林火序独有却出现130%值', x['name'], x['b130']))
        continue
    if x['b130'] in (None, ''):
        bad.append(('缺失130%值', x['name'], x['b']))
    elif abs(x['b130'] - x['b'] * 1.3) > 1e-6:
        bad.append(('130%算错', x['name'], x['b'], x['b130']))
print('130% 计算校验:', 'OK' if not bad else bad)

n130 = sum(1 for x in rows if x['b'] is not None)
print('有 130% 值的行数:', n130, '(应等于兵哥菜品数 63)')

samples = [(x['name'], x['b'], round(x['b130'], 2)) for x in rows[:6] if x['b'] is not None]
print('样例:', samples)

for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
    if ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value == '合计':
        print('合计行:', [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 11)][:9])

ws2 = wb['分类汇总']
print('汇总表头:', [ws2.cell(row=3, column=c).value for c in range(1, 9)])
for r in range(4, ws2.max_row + 1):
    vals = [ws2.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 9)]
    if vals[0]:
        print('汇总:', vals)
print('autofilter:', ws.auto_filter.ref, '| print:', ws.print_area)
", "file_path": "C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\bingge\verify_130.py"}

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""在 Wikimedia Commons 上检索饮料商品图候选。"""
import json
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

API = 'https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php'
UA = {'User-Agent': 'menu-image-search/1.0 (contact: local)'}

QUERIES = {
    'cocacola': ['Coca-Cola can', 'Coca Cola 330 ml can', 'Coca-Cola bottle'],
    'pepsi': ['Pepsi can', 'Pepsi 330 ml'],
    'sprite': ['Sprite can', 'Sprite 330 ml', 'Sprite bottle'],
    'budweiser': ['Budweiser bottle', 'Budweiser beer', 'Budweiser can'],
    'becks': ["Beck's beer bottle", "Beck's Bremen beer", 'Beck’s bottle'],
    'jdb': ['JDB herbal tea', '加多宝', 'Jiaduobao', 'Chinese herbal tea can'],
}


def search(term, limit=12):
    params = {
        'action': 'query',
        'format': 'json',
        'generator': 'search',
        'gsrsearch': f'filetype:bitmap {term}',
        'gsrnamespace': '6',
        'gsrlimit': str(limit),
        'prop': 'imageinfo',
        'iiprop': 'url|size|mime|extmetadata',
        'iiurlwidth': '1200',
    }
    url = API + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        data = json.load(r)
    pages = data.get('query', {}).get('pages', {})
    out = []
    for p in pages.values():
        ii = p.get('imageinfo', [{}])[0]
        meta = ii.get('extmetadata', {})
        out.append({
            'title': p.get('title'),
            'w': ii.get('width'),
            'h': ii.get('height'),
            'thumb': ii.get('thumburl'),
            'url': ii.get('url'),
            'license': meta.get('LicenseShortName', {}).get('value'),
            'artist': meta.get('Artist', {}).get('value', '')[:80],
        })
    return out


for key, terms in QUERIES.items():
    print('=' * 20, key)
    seen = set()
    for t in terms:
        try:
            res = search(t)
        except Exception as e:
            print('  ERR', t, e)
            continue
        for it in res:
            if it['title'] in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(it['title'])
            if (it['w'] or 0) < 600:
                continue
            print(f"  {it['w']}x{it['h']} {it['license']} | {it['title']}")
            print(f"     {it['thumb']}")
", "file_path": "C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks\search_commons.py"}

import sys, io, json, urllib.parse, urllib.request
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')
API='https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php'
UA={'User-Agent':'menu-image-search/1.0'}
def search(term, limit=10):
    p={'action':'query','format':'json','generator':'search','gsrsearch':'filetype:bitmap '+term,
       'gsrnamespace':'6','gsrlimit':str(limit),'prop':'imageinfo',
       'iiprop':'url|size|extmetadata','iiurlwidth':'1200'}
    req=urllib.request.Request(API+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(p), headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r: d=json.load(r)
    out=[]
    for pg in d.get('query',{}).get('pages',{}).values():
        ii=pg.get('imageinfo',[{}])[0]
        out.append((ii.get('width'),ii.get('height'),ii.get('extmetadata',{}).get('LicenseShortName',{}).get('value'),
                    pg.get('title'), ii.get('thumburl')))
    return out
for term in [\"Beck's beer\", 'Jiaduobao', '加多宝', 'JDB tea', 'herbal tea can China', 'Wanglaoji can']:
    print('=====', term)
    try:
        for w,h,lic,t,u in search(term):
            if (w or 0) < 500: continue
            print(f'  {w}x{h} {lic} | {t}')
            print('   ', u)
    except Exception as e:
        print('  ERR', e)
"@ 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath "$wd\search2.txt" -Encoding utf8

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""把选中的素材做成 1000×1000 的外卖商品图（方图 + 带字版）。"""
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'raw')
OUT = os.path.join(WD, 'out')
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

FONT = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc'
FONT_BD = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyhbd.ttc'
SIZE = 1000

# (序号, 商品名, 规格, 源文件, 焦点x, 焦点y, 说明)
ITEMS = [
    (1, '可口可乐', '330ml', 'coke1', 0.50, 0.42),
    (2, '百事可乐', '330ml', 'pepsi_cn', 0.40, 0.33),
    (3, '雪碧', '330ml', 'sprite1', 0.50, 0.50),
    (4, '百威啤酒', '330ml', 'bud1', 0.50, 0.45),
    (5, '贝克啤酒', '330ml', 'beck2', 0.50, 0.50),
    (6, '加多宝', '310ml', 'jdb1', 0.46, 0.40),
]


def cover(im, fx, fy, size=SIZE):
    w, h = im.size
    side = min(w, h)
    cx, cy = int(w * fx), int(h * fy)
    x0 = min(max(cx - side // 2, 0), w - side)
    y0 = min(max(cy - side // 2, 0), h - side)
    crop = im.crop((x0, y0, x0 + side, y0 + side))
    return crop.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)


def polish(im):
    im = ImageEnhance.Brightness(im).enhance(1.03)
    im = ImageEnhance.Contrast(im).enhance(1.06)
    im = ImageEnhance.Color(im).enhance(1.05)
    im = im.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=2, percent=60, threshold=2))
    return im


def with_band(im, name, spec):
    """底部渐变条 + 品名，做成一整套风格统一的宣传图。"""
    canvas = im.convert('RGB').copy()
    band_h = 210
    overlay = Image.new('RGBA', canvas.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    for i in range(band_h):
        y = SIZE - band_h + i
        a = int(215 * (i / band_h) ** 0.75)
        d.line([(0, y), (SIZE, y)], fill=(28, 8, 8, a))
    canvas = Image.alpha_composite(canvas.convert('RGBA'), overlay).convert('RGB')

    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    f_name = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BD, 84)
    f_spec = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 52)
    f_tip = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 34)

    # 左侧红色竖条作为装饰
    d.rectangle([70, SIZE - 168, 78, SIZE - 74], fill=(224, 32, 32))
    d.text((100, SIZE - 178), name, font=f_name, fill=(255, 255, 255))
    nw = d.textlength(name, font=f_name)
    d.text((100 + nw + 18, SIZE - 152), spec, font=f_spec, fill=(255, 220, 190))
    d.text((100, SIZE - 84), '冰镇即饮 · 堂食外卖均有', font=f_tip, fill=(255, 235, 235))
    return canvas


for no, name, spec, key, fx, fy in ITEMS:
    src = Image.open(os.path.join(RAW, key + '.jpg')).convert('RGB')
    sq = polish(cover(src, fx, fy))
    plain = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}.jpg')
    sq.save(plain, quality=92, subsampling=1)
    band = with_band(sq, name, spec)
    banded = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}_带字.jpg')
    band.save(banded, quality=92, subsampling=1)
    print(os.path.basename(plain), sq.size, '|', os.path.basename(banded))

# 预览大图（3×2）
cols, rows = 3, 2
cell = 420
pad = 14
W = cols * (cell + pad) + pad
H = rows * (cell + pad) + pad
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), (245, 245, 245))
for i, (no, name, spec, key, fx, fy) in enumerate(ITEMS):
    p = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}_带字.jpg')
    im = Image.open(p).resize((cell, cell), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = pad + (i % cols) * (cell + pad)
    y = pad + (i // cols) * (cell + pad)
    sheet.paste(im, (x, y))
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'preview.jpg'), quality=88)
print('preview', sheet.size)
", "file_path": "C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks\make_images.py"}

"""把选中的素材做成 1000×1000 的外卖商品图（方图 + 带字版）。"""
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'raw')
OUT = os.path.join(WD, 'out')
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

FONT = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc'
FONT_BD = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyhbd.ttc'
SIZE = 1000

# (序号, 商品名, 规格, 源文件, 焦点x, 焦点y, 说明)
ITEMS = [
    (1, '可口可乐', '330ml', 'coke1', 0.50, 0.42),
    (2, '百事可乐', '330ml', 'pepsi_cn', 0.40, 0.33),
    (3, '雪碧', '330ml', 'sprite1', 0.50, 0.50),
    (4, '百威啤酒', '330ml', 'bud1', 0.50, 0.45),
    (5, '贝克啤酒', '330ml', 'beck2', 0.50, 0.50),
    (6, '加多宝', '310ml', 'jdb1', 0.46, 0.40),
]


def cover(im, fx, fy, size=SIZE):
    w, h = im.size
    side = min(w, h)
    cx, cy = int(w * fx), int(h * fy)
    x0 = min(max(cx - side // 2, 0), w - side)
    y0 = min(max(cy - side // 2, 0), h - side)
    crop = im.crop((x0, y0, x0 + side, y0 + side))
    return crop.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)


def polish(im):
    im = ImageEnhance.Brightness(im).enhance(1.03)
    im = ImageEnhance.Contrast(im).enhance(1.06)
    im = ImageEnhance.Color(im).enhance(1.05)
    im = im.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=2, percent=60, threshold=2))
    return im


def with_band(im, name, spec):
    """底部渐变条 + 品名，做成一整套风格统一的宣传图。"""
    canvas = im.convert('RGB').copy()
    band_h = 210
    overlay = Image.new('RGBA', canvas.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    for i in range(band_h):
        y = SIZE - band_h + i
        a = int(215 * (i / band_h) ** 0.75)
        d.line([(0, y), (SIZE, y)], fill=(28, 8, 8, a))
    canvas = Image.alpha_composite(canvas.convert('RGBA'), overlay).convert('RGB')

    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    f_name = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BD, 84)
    f_spec = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 52)
    f_tip = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 34)

    # 左侧红色竖条作为装饰
    d.rectangle([70, SIZE - 168, 78, SIZE - 74], fill=(224, 32, 32))
    d.text((100, SIZE - 178), name, font=f_name, fill=(255, 255, 255))
    nw = d.textlength(name, font=f_name)
    d.text((100 + nw + 18, SIZE - 152), spec, font=f_spec, fill=(255, 220, 190))
    d.text((100, SIZE - 84), '冰镇即饮 · 堂食外卖均有', font=f_tip, fill=(255, 235, 235))
    return canvas


for no, name, spec, key, fx, fy in ITEMS:
    src = Image.open(os.path.join(RAW, key + '.jpg')).convert('RGB')
    sq = polish(cover(src, fx, fy))
    plain = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}.jpg')
    sq.save(plain, quality=92, subsampling=1)
    band = with_band(sq, name, spec)
    banded = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}_带字.jpg')
    band.save(banded, quality=92, subsampling=1)
    print(os.path.basename(plain), sq.size, '|', os.path.basename(banded))

# 预览大图（3×2）
cols, rows = 3, 2
cell = 420
pad = 14
W = cols * (cell + pad) + pad
H = rows * (cell + pad) + pad
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), (245, 245, 245))
for i, (no, name, spec, key, fx, fy) in enumerate(ITEMS):
    p = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}_带字.jpg')
    im = Image.open(p).resize((cell, cell), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = pad + (i % cols) * (cell + pad)
    y = pad + (i // cols) * (cell + pad)
    sheet.paste(im, (x, y))
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'preview.jpg'), quality=88)
print('preview', sheet.size)

"""方案 B：卡片式排版（浅暖底 + 圆角照片 + 底部色条），不裁切商品。"""
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'raw')
OUT = os.path.join(WD, 'out2')
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

FONT = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc'
FONT_BD = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyhbd.ttc'
SIZE = 1000
BAND = 200          # 底部色条高度
CARD_TOP = 44
CARD_BOTTOM = SIZE - BAND - 24
SIDE = 56

ITEMS = [
    (1, '可口可乐', '330ml', 'coke1'),
    (2, '百事可乐', '330ml', 'pepsi_cn'),
    (3, '雪碧', '330ml', 'sprite1'),
    (4, '百威啤酒', '330ml', 'bud1'),
    (5, '贝克啤酒', '330ml', 'beck2'),
    (6, '加多宝', '310ml', 'jdb1'),
]


def bg_canvas():
    """浅暖色渐变底。"""
    base = Image.new('RGB', (SIZE, SIZE), (252, 249, 245))
    top = Image.new('RGB', (SIZE, SIZE), (255, 253, 250))
    mask = Image.linear_gradient('L').resize((SIZE, SIZE))
    return Image.composite(top, base, mask.point(lambda v: 255 - v))


def rounded(im, radius):
    mask = Image.new('L', im.size, 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    d.rounded_rectangle([0, 0, im.size[0] - 1, im.size[1] - 1], radius=radius, fill=255)
    out = im.convert('RGBA')
    out.putalpha(mask)
    return out


def photo_card(src):
    max_w, max_h = SIZE - 2 * SIDE, CARD_BOTTOM - CARD_TOP
    im = src.copy()
    im.thumbnail((max_w, max_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    im = ImageEnhance.Contrast(im).enhance(1.05)
    im = ImageEnhance.Color(im).enhance(1.04)
    im = im.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=2, percent=55, threshold=2))
    return rounded(im, 26)


def compose(src, path, name, spec):
    canvas = bg_canvas().convert('RGBA')
    card = photo_card(src)
    x = (SIZE - card.size[0]) // 2
    y = CARD_TOP + (CARD_BOTTOM - CARD_TOP - card.size[1]) // 2

    # 阴影
    sh = Image.new('RGBA', (SIZE, SIZE), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
    d.rounded_rectangle([x + 6, y + 14, x + card.size[0] + 6, y + card.size[1] + 14],
                        radius=26, fill=(120, 80, 60, 90))
    sh = sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18))
    canvas = Image.alpha_composite(canvas, sh)
    canvas.alpha_composite(card, (x, y))

    # 底部色条
    band = Image.new('RGBA', (SIZE, BAND), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    bd = ImageDraw.Draw(band)
    for i in range(BAND):
        t = i / BAND
        bd.line([(0, i), (SIZE, i)],
                fill=(int(150 + 60 * t), int(16 + 6 * t), int(16 + 6 * t), 255))
    canvas.alpha_composite(band, (0, SIZE - BAND))

    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    f_name = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BD, 80)
    f_spec = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 50)
    ty = SIZE - BAND + 42
    d.rectangle([SIDE, ty + 6, SIDE + 9, ty + 92], fill=(255, 214, 120))
    d.text((SIDE + 26, ty - 4), name, font=f_name, fill=(255, 255, 255))
    nw = d.textlength(name, font=f_name)
    d.text((SIDE + 26 + nw + 16, ty + 24), spec, font=f_spec, fill=(255, 226, 190))
    d.text((SIDE + 26, ty + 108), '冰镇即饮', font=ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 34),
           fill=(255, 235, 235))

    canvas.convert('RGB').save(path, quality=93, subsampling=1)


for no, name, spec, key in ITEMS:
    src = Image.open(os.path.join(RAW, key + '.jpg')).convert('RGB')
    p = os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}.jpg')
    compose(src, p, name, spec)
    print(os.path.basename(p))

cols, rows = 3, 2
cell, pad = 420, 14
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (cols * (cell + pad) + pad, rows * (cell + pad) + pad), (240, 240, 240))
for i, (no, name, spec, key) in enumerate(ITEMS):
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(OUT, f'{no:02d}_{name}_{spec}.jpg')).resize((cell, cell), Image.LANCZOS)
    sheet.paste(im, (pad + (i % cols) * (cell + pad), pad + (i // cols) * (cell + pad)))
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'preview2.jpg'), quality=88)
print('preview2', sheet.size)

import io
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.parse

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'raw2')
os.makedirs(RAW, exist_ok=True)
API = 'https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php'
UA = {'User-Agent': 'menu-image-search/1.0'}

TERMS = {
    'coke': ['Coca-Cola can front', 'Coca-Cola Dose', 'Coca Cola 330 ml can', 'Coca-Cola can single'],
    'pepsi': ['Pepsi can front', 'Pepsi Dose', 'Pepsi 330 ml can', 'Pepsi can single'],
    'sprite': ['Sprite Dose', 'Sprite lemon lime can', 'Sprite soft drink can', 'Sprite blikje', '雪碧'],
    'bud': ['Budweiser Can', 'Budweiser Dose', 'Budweiser can single'],
    'beck': ["Beck's Gold can", "Beck's (Brauerei Beck & Co.)", "Beck's Ice", "Beck's can"],
    'jdb': ['JDB drink', '加多宝'],
}


def search(term, limit=8):
    p = {'action': 'query', 'format': 'json', 'generator': 'search',
         'gsrsearch': 'filetype:bitmap ' + term, 'gsrnamespace': '6',
         'gsrlimit': str(limit), 'prop': 'imageinfo',
         'iiprop': 'url|size|extmetadata', 'iiurlwidth': '1100'}
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(p), headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        d = json.load(r)
    out = []
    for pg in d.get('query', {}).get('pages', {}).values():
        ii = pg.get('imageinfo', [{}])[0]
        m = ii.get('extmetadata', {})
        out.append({
            'title': pg['title'], 'w': ii.get('width'), 'h': ii.get('height'),
            'thumb': ii.get('thumburl'), 'page': ii.get('descriptionurl'),
            'lic': m.get('LicenseShortName', {}).get('value'),
            'artist': m.get('Artist', {}).get('value', ''),
        })
    return out


def download(url, path):
    for _ in range(3):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
                data = r.read()
            open(path, 'wb').write(data)
            Image.open(path).verify()
            return True
        except Exception:
            continue
    return False


picked = []
seen = set()
for brand, terms in TERMS.items():
    cands = []
    for t in terms:
        try:
            for it in search(t):
                if it['title'] in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(it['title'])
                low = it['title'].lower()
                # 只要罐装相关（名字里带 can/dose/罐/饮品照），并且够大
                if (it['w'] or 0) < 800:
                    continue
                cands.append(it)
        except Exception as e:
            print('  ERR', brand, t, e)
    cands = cands[:4]
    print('==', brand, len(cands))
    for i, it in enumerate(cands):
        p = os.path.join(RAW, f'{brand}_{i}.jpg')
        ok = download(it['thumb'], p)
        print('  ', 'OK ' if ok else 'FAIL', it['title'], it['w'], 'x', it['h'], it['lic'])
        if ok:
            it['path'] = p
            picked.append((brand, i, it))

# 对照图
CELL, PAD, COLS = 300, 10, 6
rows = (len(picked) + COLS - 1) // COLS
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 34 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 15)
for k, (brand, i, it) in enumerate(picked):
    im = Image.open(it['path']).convert('RGB')
    im.thumbnail((CELL, CELL), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)
    y = PAD + (k // COLS) * (CELL + 34 + PAD)
    sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
    d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(210, 210, 210))
    d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 4), f'{brand}_{i}', fill='black', font=font)
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'cans.jpg'), quality=85)
print('sheet', sheet.size, 'picked', len(picked))
json.dump([{'brand': b, 'i': i, 'title': it['title'], 'lic': it['lic'],
            'artist': it['artist'], 'page': it['page']} for b, i, it in picked],
          open(os.path.join(WD, 'cans.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

    'sprite': ['Sprite Dose', 'Sprite lemon lime can', 'Sprite soft drink can', 'Sprite blikje', '雪碧'],
    'bud': ['Budweiser Can', 'Budweiser Dose', 'Budweiser can single'],
    'beck': ["Beck's Gold can", "Beck's (Brauerei Beck & Co.)", "Beck's Ice", "Beck's can"],
    'jdb': ['JDB drink', '加多宝'],
}


def search(term, limit=8):
    p = {'action': 'query', 'format': 'json', 'generator': 'search',
         'gsrsearch': 'filetype:bitmap ' + term, 'gsrnamespace': '6',
         'gsrlimit': str(limit), 'prop': 'imageinfo',
         'iiprop': 'url|size|extmetadata', 'iiurlwidth': '1100'}
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(p), headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        d = json.load(r)
    out = []
    for pg in d.get('query', {}).get('pages', {}).values():
        ii = pg.get('imageinfo', [{}])[0]
        m = ii.get('extmetadata', {})
        out.append({
            'title': pg['title'], 'w': ii.get('width'), 'h': ii.get('height'),
            'thumb': ii.get('thumburl'), 'page': ii.get('descriptionurl'),
            'lic': m.get('LicenseShortName', {}).get('value'),
            'artist': m.get('Artist', {}).get('value', ''),
        })
    return out


def download(url, path):
    for _ in range(3):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
                data = r.read()
            open(path, 'wb').write(data)
            Image.open(path).verify()
            return True
        except Exception:
            continue
    return False


picked = []
seen = set()
for brand, terms in TERMS.items():
    cands = []
    for t in terms:
        try:
            for it in search(t):
                if it['title'] in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(it['title'])
                low = it['title'].lower()
                # 只要罐装相关（名字里带 can/dose/罐/饮品照），并且够大
                if (it['w'] or 0) < 800:
                    continue
                cands.append(it)
        except Exception as e:
            print('  ERR', brand, t, e)
    cands = cands[:4]
    print('==', brand, len(cands))
    for i, it in enumerate(cands):
        p = os.path.join(RAW, f'{brand}_{i}.jpg')
        ok = download(it['thumb'], p)
        print('  ', 'OK ' if ok else 'FAIL', it['title'], it['w'], 'x', it['h'], it['lic'])
        if ok:

CELL, PAD, COLS = 300, 10, 6

sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 34 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')

font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 15)
for k, (brand, i, it) in enumerate(picked):
    im = Image.open(it['path']).convert('RGB')

    x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)

    sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
    d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(210, 210, 210))
    d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 4), f'{brand}_{i}', fill='black', font=font)
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'cans.jpg'), quality=85)

Choose bud_0 (left can, cleaner) or bud_3. Both 800.

1. coke: raw7/coke_2 (500, single 中国版罐, clean) → upscale
2. pepsi: raw5/pepsi_0 (800) crop right can
3. sprite: raw5/sprite_0 (480, single 雪碧摩登罐) → upscale

6. jdb: raw5/jdb_1 (800) crop left can

Composition: trim to the can, fit into 1000 square with ~8% margin, pure white bg, mild sharpen, slight levels to whiten background.

But cans vary in aspect; to keep the set visually consistent, normalize each can to ~86% of the canvas height, centered, with a soft shadow? A subtle shadow makes it look like a product photo. Since I'm compositing on white with known bounding box (after trim), I can add a soft elliptical shadow under the can. Risky (shadow under can without base). Skip shadow; pure white + slight bottom gradient? Keep simple: white bg, can centered.

Also for consistency, all cans should appear similar size — normalize by height: can height = 0.84 * 1000 = 840.

For 带字版: add bottom band? On white background a red band looks fine and consistent with earlier set. But now the images are white-bg; the band will sit on white. Hmm, earlier set had warm bg. New set: white.

Decision: produce
- 纯图: white 1000×1000, can centered at 86% height (clean, like JD 主图)
- 带字: same + red bottom band "品名 + 规格"

I'll write the composer with manual crop boxes for each source to isolate the single can:

- coke_2 (500x500): can occupies nearly all; trim white auto.
- pepsi_0 (800x800): crop x 440-800 (right can).
- sprite_0 (480x480): can centered; trim auto.
- bud_0 (800x800): crop x 0-260 roughly (left can). Let me check coordinates by looking at the image later; use auto-trim after cropping a generous region.
- beck_2 (800x800): single can centered; trim auto.
- jdb_1 (800x800): crop x 20-340, y 150-700.

Auto-trim: find bbox of pixels darker than near-white (sum < 735) — but cans have white parts (Bud label is white!). Trimming by "non-white" would cut the white label areas. Hmm. For a can on white, the bbox of non-background pixels: white label regions are enclosed by colored edges, but the bbox is computed over all non-white pixels, so the can's dark parts define bbox... a white can (Budweiser) is mostly white with red/blue text; the outline may be white-on-white → bbox may shrink.

Safer: manual boxes. Let me view candidates with a grid overlay to pick boxes precisely. That's 6 trips... heavy.

Alternative: compute bbox with a tolerance-based approach: background is pure-ish white (>=250). Pixels that are <250 in any channel count. Bud can's white area is ~white but has slight shading (not pure 255) → likely detected. Let's try auto-trim with threshold 250 and min area; then visually verify the composed sheet.

I'll implement: trim(img, thresh=248) → bbox of pixels where min(R,G,B) < thresh, with 5px padding, then fit by height.

Then compose all 6, make preview, inspect. Adjust individual crops only if needed.

import io
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'beck330')
os.makedirs(RAW, exist_ok=True)

UA = ('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 '
      '(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36')
REFS = ['https://item.jd.com/', 'https://image.so.com/', 'https://www.suning.com/',
        'https://item.taobao.com/', 'https://www.tmall.com/']

QUERIES = [
    '贝克啤酒330ml罐装',
    '贝克 330ml 易拉罐',
    "BECK'S 330ml 罐",
    '贝克啤酒 330ml 听装',
    'becks 贝克 330ml 罐装 单罐',
]


def so360(q, rn=40):
    url = 'https://image.so.com/j?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {'q': q, 'src': 'srp', 'pn': '0', 'rn': str(rn)})
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': UA,
                                              'Referer': 'https://image.so.com/'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')).get('list', [])


def dl(url, minside):
    for ref in REFS:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                'User-Agent': UA, 'Referer': ref, 'Accept': 'image/*,*/*;q=0.8'})
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            im.verify()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            if min(im.size) < minside:
                return None, None
            if im.mode != 'RGB':
                im = im.convert('RGB')
            b = io.BytesIO()
            im.save(b, 'JPEG', quality=95)
            return b.getvalue(), im.size
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None


saved, seen = [], set()
for q in QUERIES:
    if len(saved) >= 9:
        break
    try:
        items = so360(q)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR', q, e)
        continue
    for it in items:
        if len(saved) >= 9:
            break
        key = it.get('imgkey') or it.get('img')
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        title = (it.get('title') or '')
        for url, ms in ((it.get('img'), 700), (it.get('thumb'), 470)):
            if not url:
                continue
            data, size = dl(url, ms)
            if not data:
                continue
            p = os.path.join(RAW, f'beck_{len(saved)}.jpg')
            open(p, 'wb').write(data)
            saved.append({'path': p, 'size': size, 'title': title[:40],
                          'src': it.get('dspurl')})
            print(f"  {len(saved)-1} {size} {title[:28]} | {it.get('dspurl')}")
            break

CELL, PAD, COLS = 320, 10, 3
rows = max(1, (len(saved) + COLS - 1) // COLS)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 32 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 14)
for k, it in enumerate(saved):
    im = Image.open(it['path'])
    im.thumbnail((CELL, CELL), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)
    y = PAD + (k // COLS) * (CELL + 32 + PAD)
    sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
    d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(205, 205, 205))
    d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 5), f'beck_{it["path"].split("_")[-1].split(".")[0]} {it["size"]}',
           fill='black', font=font)
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'beck330.jpg'), quality=88)
print('picked', len(saved), sheet.size)

"""找贝克啤酒 330ml 罐装图。"""
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'beck330')
os.makedirs(RAW, exist_ok=True)

UA = ('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 '
      '(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36')
REFS = ['https://item.jd.com/', 'https://image.so.com/', 'https://www.suning.com/',
        'https://item.taobao.com/', 'https://www.tmall.com/']

QUERIES = [
    '贝克啤酒330ml罐装',
    '贝克 330ml 易拉罐',
    "BECK'S 330ml 罐",
    '贝克啤酒 330ml 听装',
    'becks 贝克 330ml 罐装 单罐',
]


def so360(q, rn=40):
    url = 'https://image.so.com/j?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {'q': q, 'src': 'srp', 'pn': '0', 'rn': str(rn)})
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': UA,
                                              'Referer': 'https://image.so.com/'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')).get('list', [])


def dl(url, minside):
    for ref in REFS:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                'User-Agent': UA, 'Referer': ref, 'Accept': 'image/*,*/*;q=0.8'})
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            im.verify()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            if min(im.size) < minside:
                return None, None
            if im.mode != 'RGB':
                im = im.convert('RGB')
            b = io.BytesIO()
            im.save(b, 'JPEG', quality=95)
            return b.getvalue(), im.size
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None


saved, seen = [], set()
for q in QUERIES:
    if len(saved) >= 9:
        break
    try:
        items = so360(q)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR', q, e)
        continue
    for it in items:
        if len(saved) >= 9:
            break
        key = it.get('imgkey') or it.get('img')
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        title = (it.get('title') or '')
        for url, ms in ((it.get('img'), 700), (it.get('thumb'), 470)):
            if not url:
                continue
            data, size = dl(url, ms)
            if not data:
                continue
            p = os.path.join(RAW, f'beck_{len(saved)}.jpg')
            open(p, 'wb').write(data)
            saved.append({'path': p, 'size': size, 'title': title[:40],
                          'src': it.get('dspurl')})
            print(f"  {len(saved)-1} {size} {title[:28]} | {it.get('dspurl')}")
            break

CELL, PAD, COLS = 320, 10, 3
rows = max(1, (len(saved) + COLS - 1) // COLS)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 32 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 14)
for k, it in enumerate(saved):
    im = Image.open(it['path'])
    im.thumbnail((CELL, CELL), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)
    y = PAD + (k // COLS) * (CELL + 32 + PAD)
    sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
    d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(205, 205, 205))
    d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 5), f'beck_{it["path"].split("_")[-1].split(".")[0]} {it["size"]}',
           fill='black', font=font)
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'beck330.jpg'), quality=88)
print('picked', len(saved), sheet.size)
", "file_path": "C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks\find_beck330.py"}

QUERIES = [
    "Beck's 330ml can",
    'becks 330 ml can beer',
    '贝克啤酒 330 毫升 罐装',
    'beck\u2019s beer can green 330',

]


def so360(q, rn=30):
    url = 'https://image.so.com/j?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {'q': q, 'src': 'srp', 'pn': '0', 'rn': str(rn)})
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': UA,
                                              'Referer': 'https://image.so.com/'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')).get('list', [])


def dl(url, minside):
    for ref in REFS:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                'User-Agent': UA, 'Referer': ref, 'Accept': 'image/*,*/*;q=0.8'})
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            im.verify()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            if min(im.size) < minside:
                return None, None
            if im.mode != 'RGB':
                im = im.convert('RGB')
            b = io.BytesIO()
            im.save(b, 'JPEG', quality=95)
            return b.getvalue(), im.size
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None


saved, seen = [], set()
for q in QUERIES:
    if len(saved) >= 9:
        break
    try:
        items = so360(q)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR', q, e)
        continue
    for it in items:
        if len(saved) >= 9:
            break
        key = it.get('imgkey') or it.get('img')
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        for url, ms in ((it.get('img'), 650), (it.get('thumb'), 470)):
            if not url:
                continue
            data, size = dl(url, ms)
            if not data:
                continue
            p = os.path.join(RAW, f'c{len(saved)}.jpg')
            open(p, 'wb').write(data)
            saved.append((p, size, (it.get('title') or '')[:34], it.get('dspurl')))
            print(f'  {len(saved)-1} {size} {(it.get("title") or "")[:30]} | {it.get("dspurl")}')
            break

CELL, PAD, COLS = 320, 10, 3
rows = max(1, (len(saved) + COLS - 1) // COLS)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 32 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 14)
for k, (p, size, title, src) in enumerate(saved):
    im = Image.open(p)
    im.thumbnail((CELL, CELL), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)
    y = PAD + (k // COLS) * (CELL + 32 + PAD)
    sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
    d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(205, 205, 205))
    d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 5), f'c{k} {size}', fill='black', font=font)
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'beck330c.jpg'), quality=88)
print('n', len(saved), sheet.size)

Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""同时检索：贝克 330ml 罐装、喜力 330ml 罐装。"""
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'cans330')
os.makedirs(RAW, exist_ok=True)

UA = ('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 '
      '(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36')
REFS = ['https://item.jd.com/', 'https://image.so.com/', 'https://www.tmall.com/',
        'https://item.taobao.com/', 'https://www.suning.com/']

QUERIES = {
    'beck': ['贝克啤酒330ml罐装', '贝克啤酒 330ml 24听', "BECK'S 贝克 330ml 易拉罐",
             'becks 330ml can beer', '贝克啤酒 330 罐 单罐'],
    'heineken': ['喜力啤酒330ml罐装', '喜力 330ml 易拉罐', 'Heineken 330ml can',
                 '喜力啤酒 330ml 24听', '喜力 330 罐装 单罐'],
}


def so360(q, rn=40):
    url = 'https://image.so.com/j?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {'q': q, 'src': 'srp', 'pn': '0', 'rn': str(rn)})
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': UA,
                                              'Referer': 'https://image.so.com/'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')).get('list', [])


def dl(url, minside):
    for ref in REFS:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                'User-Agent': UA, 'Referer': ref, 'Accept': 'image/*,*/*;q=0.8'})
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            im.verify()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            if min(im.size) < minside:
                return None, None
            if im.mode != 'RGB':
                im = im.convert('RGB')
            b = io.BytesIO()
            im.save(b, 'JPEG', quality=95)
            return b.getvalue(), im.size
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None


picked = {}
for brand, qs in QUERIES.items():
    saved, seen = [], set()
    for q in qs:
        if len(saved) >= 8:
            break
        try:
            items = so360(q)
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERR', brand, q, e)
            continue
        for it in items:
            if len(saved) >= 8:
                break
            key = it.get('imgkey') or it.get('img')
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            for url, ms in ((it.get('img'), 640), (it.get('thumb'), 470)):
                if not url:
                    continue
                data, size = dl(url, ms)
                if not data:
                    continue
                p = os.path.join(RAW, f'{brand}_{len(saved)}.jpg')
                open(p, 'wb').write(data)
                saved.append({'path': p, 'size': size,
                              'title': (it.get('title') or '')[:36],
                              'src': it.get('dspurl')})
                print(f'  {brand}_{len(saved)-1} {size} {(it.get("title") or "")[:26]} | {it.get("dspurl")}')
                break
    picked[brand] = saved
    print('==', brand, len(saved))

# 每个品牌一张对照图
for brand, saved in picked.items():
    if not saved:
        continue
    CELL, PAD, COLS = 320, 10, 4
    rows = max(1, (len(saved) + COLS - 1) // COLS)
    sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 32 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 14)
    for k, it in enumerate(saved):
        im = Image.open(it['path'])
        im.thumbnail((CELL, CELL), Image.LANCZOS)
        x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)
        y = PAD + (k // COLS) * (CELL + 32 + PAD)
        sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
        d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(205, 205, 205))
        d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 5), f'{brand}_{k} {it["size"]}', fill='black', font=font)
    sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, f'cand_{brand}.jpg'), quality=88)
    print(brand, 'sheet', sheet.size)

        sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))

            n += 1
            print(f'  d{n-1} {size} {(it.get("title") or "")[:34]} | {it.get("dspurl")}')
            break
print('total', n)

def so360(q, rn=40):
    url = 'https://image.so.com/j?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {'q': q, 'src': 'srp', 'pn': '0', 'rn': str(rn)})

    sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'hei_single.jpg'), quality=88)
    print('sheet', sheet.size)

    sheet.paste(Image.open(p).resize((cell, cell), Image.LANCZOS),

"""按店里实际 SKU（310ml）找贝克、百威的罐装图。"""
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

WD = r'C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks'
RAW = os.path.join(WD, 'sku310')
os.makedirs(RAW, exist_ok=True)

UA = ('Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 '
      '(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36')
REFS = ['https://item.jd.com/', 'https://image.so.com/', 'https://www.tmall.com/',
        'https://detail.1688.com/']

QUERIES = {
    'beck310': ['贝克啤酒310ml', '贝克啤酒 310ml 罐装', 'BECK S 贝克 310ml 易拉罐'],
    'bud310': ['百威啤酒310ml', '百威啤酒 310ml 罐装', '百威 310ml 易拉罐'],
}


def so360(q, rn=40):
    url = 'https://image.so.com/j?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {'q': q, 'src': 'srp', 'pn': '0', 'rn': str(rn)})
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': UA,
                                              'Referer': 'https://image.so.com/'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')).get('list', [])


def dl(url, minside):
    for ref in REFS:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                'User-Agent': UA, 'Referer': ref, 'Accept': 'image/*,*/*;q=0.8'})
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            im.verify()
            im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(data))
            if min(im.size) < minside:
                return None, None
            if im.mode != 'RGB':
                im = im.convert('RGB')
            b = io.BytesIO()
            im.save(b, 'JPEG', quality=95)
            return b.getvalue(), im.size
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None


for tag, qs in QUERIES.items():
    saved, seen = [], set()
    for q in qs:
        if len(saved) >= 6:
            break
        try:
            items = so360(q)
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERR', tag, q, e)
            continue
        for it in items:
            if len(saved) >= 6:
                break
            key = it.get('imgkey') or it.get('img')
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            for url, ms in ((it.get('img'), 600), (it.get('thumb'), 470)):
                if not url:
                    continue
                data, size = dl(url, ms)
                if not data:
                    continue
                p = os.path.join(RAW, f'{tag}_{len(saved)}.jpg')
                open(p, 'wb').write(data)
                saved.append((p, size, (it.get('title') or '')[:38], it.get('dspurl')))
                print(f'  {tag}_{len(saved)-1} {size} {(it.get("title") or "")[:28]} | {it.get("dspurl")}')
                break
    if not saved:
        print('==', tag, 'none')
        continue
    CELL, PAD, COLS = 320, 10, 3
    rows = max(1, (len(saved) + COLS - 1) // COLS)
    sheet = Image.new('RGB', (COLS * (CELL + PAD) + PAD, rows * (CELL + 32 + PAD) + PAD), 'white')
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    font = ImageFont.truetype(r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc', 14)
    for k, (p, size, title, src) in enumerate(saved):
        im = Image.open(p)
        im.thumbnail((CELL, CELL), Image.LANCZOS)
        x = PAD + (k % COLS) * (CELL + PAD)
        y = PAD + (k // COLS) * (CELL + 32 + PAD)
        sheet.paste(im, (x + (CELL - im.size[0]) // 2, y + (CELL - im.size[1]) // 2))
        d.rectangle([x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL], outline=(205, 205, 205))
        d.text((x + 3, y + CELL + 5), f'{tag}_{k} {size}', fill='black', font=font)
    sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, f'sku_{tag}.jpg'), quality=88)
    print('==', tag, len(saved), sheet.size)

FONT_BD = r'C:\Windows\Fonts\msyhbd.ttc'

    ('喜力啤酒', '330ml', '07_喜力啤酒_330ml.jpg', (0, 118, 62),

]


def trim_white(im, tol=246, pad=6):
    gray = im.convert('L')
    bbox = gray.point(lambda v: 255 if v < tol else 0).getbbox()
    if not bbox:
        return im
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    w, h = im.size
    return im.crop((max(0, x0 - pad), max(0, y0 - pad), min(w, x1 + pad), min(h, y1 + pad)))


def rounded_mask(size, radius):
    m = Image.new('L', size, 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(m).rounded_rectangle([0, 0, size[0] - 1, size[1] - 1],
                                        radius=radius, fill=255)
    return m


def build(can_path, name, spec, color, points, badge, with_card=True):
    canvas = Image.new('RGB', (SIZE, SIZE), 'white')
    can = trim_white(Image.open(can_path).convert('RGB'))

    if with_card:
        card_box = (44, 64, 452, 936)
        # 阴影
        sh = Image.new('RGBA', (SIZE, SIZE), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        ImageDraw.Draw(sh).rounded_rectangle(
            [card_box[0] + 6, card_box[1] + 12, card_box[2] + 6, card_box[3] + 12],
            radius=38, fill=(0, 0, 0, 45))
        canvas = Image.alpha_composite(canvas.convert('RGBA'),
                                       sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(16))).convert('RGB')

        card = Image.new('RGB', (card_box[2] - card_box[0], card_box[3] - card_box[1]), color)
        canvas.paste(card, (card_box[0], card_box[1]),
                     rounded_mask(card.size, 38))

        d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        f_name = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BD, 46)
        f_point = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BD, 54)
        f_spec = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 34)

        x0 = card_box[0] + 34
        d.text((x0, card_box[1] + 40), name, font=f_name, fill=(255, 255, 255))
        d.line([(x0, card_box[1] + 118), (x0 + 52, card_box[1] + 118)],
               fill=(255, 214, 120), width=5)

        y = card_box[1] + 168
        for p in points:
            d.text((x0, y), p, font=f_point, fill=(255, 255, 255))
            y += 84
        d.text((x0, card_box[3] - 74), spec, font=f_spec, fill=(255, 226, 190))

        can_h = 742
        can_area_x = card_box[2] + 30
    else:
        can_h = 812
        can_area_x = 0

    scale = can_h / can.size[1]
    can = can.resize((max(1, int(can.size[0] * scale)), can_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    avail_w = SIZE - can_area_x - 24
    if can.size[0] > avail_w:
        ratio = avail_w / can.size[0]
        can = can.resize((avail_w, int(can_h * ratio)), Image.LANCZOS)
    x = can_area_x + (SIZE - can_area_x - can.size[0]) // 2 if with_card else (SIZE - can.size[0]) // 2
    y = 900 - can.size[1]
    canvas.paste(can, (x, y))

    if with_card:
        # 角标
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        f_b = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 30)
        tw = d.textlength(badge, font=f_b)
        bx, by = SIZE - tw - 78, 58
        d.rounded_rectangle([bx, by, bx + tw + 40, by + 48], radius=24,
                            fill=(255, 255, 255), outline=(226, 226, 226), width=2)
        d.text((bx + 20, by + 8), badge, font=f_b, fill=(90, 90, 90))
    return canvas


for name, spec, fname, color, points, badge in ITEMS:
    src = os.path.join(SRC, fname)
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        print('missing', src)
        continue
    base = f'{name}_{spec}'
    build(src, name, spec, color, points, badge, True).save(
        os.path.join(OUT, '卡片', base + '.jpg'), quality=93, subsampling=1)
    build(src, name, spec, color, points, badge, False).save(
        os.path.join(OUT, '纯图', base + '.jpg'), quality=93, subsampling=1)
    print(base)

# 预览
items = [f'{n}_{s}' for n, s, *_ in ITEMS]
cols, rows, cell, pad = 4, 2, 330, 14
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (cols * (cell + pad) + pad, rows * (cell + pad) + pad), (240, 240, 240))
for k, base in enumerate(items):
    p = os.path.join(OUT, '卡片', base + '.jpg')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        continue
    sheet.paste(Image.open(p).resize((cell, cell), Image.LANCZOS),
                (pad + (k % cols) * (cell + pad), pad + (k // cols) * (cell + pad)))
sheet.save(os.path.join(WD, 'card_preview.jpg'), quality=90)
print('preview', sheet.size)

    return im.crop((max(0, x0 - pad), max(0, y0 - pad), min(w, x1 + pad), min(h, y1 + pad)))


def compose(can, name, spec, with_band):
    target_h = int(SIZE * 0.84 * (0.78 if with_band else 1.0))
    scale = target_h / can.size[1]
    can = can.resize((max(1, int(can.size[0] * scale)), target_h), Image.LANCZOS)
    can = can.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=1.6, percent=70, threshold=2))
    can = ImageEnhance.Contrast(can).enhance(1.04)

    canvas = Image.new('RGB', (SIZE, SIZE), 'white')
    x = (SIZE - can.size[0]) // 2
    y = 60 if with_band else (SIZE - can.size[1]) // 2 - 10
    canvas.paste(can, (x, y))

    if with_band:
        band_h = 200
        grad = Image.new('L', (1, band_h))
        for i in range(band_h):

        grad = grad.resize((SIZE, band_h))
        base = Image.new('RGB', (SIZE, band_h), (200, 26, 26))
        dark = Image.new('RGB', (SIZE, band_h), (118, 10, 10))
        canvas.paste(Image.composite(base, dark, grad), (0, SIZE - band_h))
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        f_name = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BD, 80)
        f_spec = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 50)
        ty = SIZE - band_h + 42
        d.rectangle([56, ty + 6, 65, ty + 92], fill=(255, 214, 120))
        d.text((82, ty - 4), name, font=f_name, fill='white')
        nw = d.textlength(name, font=f_name)
        d.text((82 + nw + 16, ty + 24), spec, font=f_spec, fill=(255, 226, 190))
        d.text((82, ty + 108), '冰镇即饮', font=ImageFont.truetype(FONT, 34),
               fill=(255, 235, 235))
    return canvas

    """按“有效像素”求外接框，忽略零星底纹。"""
    import numpy as np
    gray = np.asarray(im.convert('L')).astype(int)
    mask = gray < tol
    rows = np.where(mask.sum(axis=1) >= min_px)[0]
    cols = np.where(mask.sum(axis=0) >= min_px)[0]
    if len(rows) == 0 or len(cols) == 0:
        return im
    x0, x1 = cols[0], cols[-1]
    y0, y1 = rows[0], rows[-1]
    w, h = im.size
    return im.crop((max(0, x0 - pad), max(0, y0 - pad),
                    min(w, x1 + pad), min(h, y1 + pad)))", "old_string": "def trim_white(im, tol=246, pad=6):
    gray = im.convert('L')

    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    w, h = im.size
    return im.crop((max(0, x0 - pad), max(0, y0 - pad), min(w, x1 + pad), min(h, y1 + pad)))"}

{"content": "饮料商品图 · 来源与使用说明
============================================

更新日期：2026-10-28
尺寸：1000×1000 px，JPG

三套版式，按需取用：
  卖点卡片/  ← 推荐用这套。左边品牌色卡片写卖点，右边放罐子，和你店里
               贝克、百威现在那两张图是同一个路子，七款摆一起成系列
  纯图/      ← 白底单罐，最干净，平台缩略图小的时候反而清楚
  带字/      ← 早先版本：底部红条 + 品名规格（留作备用，可删）

七款商品
--------------------------------------------
1. 可口可乐 330ml    中国版红罐，卖点：经典原味 / 气泡十足
2. 百事可乐 330ml    中国版蓝罐，卖点：畅爽带劲 / 冰镇更好喝
3. 雪碧    330ml     中国版绿罐，卖点：柠檬清爽 / 冰镇透心凉
4. 百威啤酒 310ml    经典白红罐，卖点：百年经典 / 醇厚麦香 / 美式拉格
5. 贝克啤酒 310ml    德国贝克 310ml 罐（已换成 310ml 版，不再是 500ml）
                    卖点：100%纯麦德啤 / 入口顺滑 / 经典拉格
6. 加多宝  310ml     金罐，卖点：正宗凉茶 / 草本配方 / 清润解腻
7. 喜力啤酒 330ml    经典绿罐，卖点：全麦酿造 / 清爽微苦 / 经典绿罐

素材来源
--------------------------------------------
· 可口可乐、百事可乐、雪碧、百威、加多宝、喜力：电商平台商品主图
  （京东 item.jd.com / item.m.jd.com、淘宝、1688 等），白底单罐抠图
· 贝克 310ml：京东「德国贝克啤酒310ml*24听」商品主图
· 分辨率：可乐、雪碧原始素材约 480–500px，放大到 1000px；
  其余 800px 以上。手机缩略图都没问题，做主图大图时可乐/雪碧会略软。

使用提醒
--------------------------------------------
1) 这些是电商平台/商家公开的商品主图，版权属于品牌方或原发布商家。
   外卖平台日常使用很普遍，但严格意义上商用建议向供货商索要官方图，或取得授权。
2) 卡片上的卖点文案是我按品类写的通用描述，不涉及功效承诺；
   如果你想换成自己店里的说法（比如「冰镇现开」「买二送一」），告诉我改。
3) 图上含品牌商标，用于说明你所销售的该品牌商品属于正当使用，
   不要做成让人觉得是品牌官方合作的样子。
4) 你的菜单里还有「王老吉 310ml」，这套图里没有；需要的话我再补一张同版式。

按你店里那种「罐子 + 卖点卡片」的版面做了一套，7 款都在 [饮料商品图\卖点卡片](C:\Users\24380\Downloads\烧烤\兵哥烧烤菜单\饮料商品图\卖点卡片)。

![卖点卡片版](C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\drinks\card_preview.jpg)

**贝克这次对了**：找到京东「德国贝克啤酒 **310ml**×24听」的商品主图，单罐白底、罐身就是 310ml 那一款（矮罐，BECK'S + BREMEN·GERMANY），不再是 500ml。百威也按 310ml 标注。

| 商品 | 卖点文案 |
|---|---|
| 可口可乐 330ml | 经典原味 / 气泡十足 |
| 百事可乐 330ml | 畅爽带劲 / 冰镇更好喝 |
| 雪碧 330ml | 柠檬清爽 / 冰镇透心凉 |
| 百威啤酒 310ml | 百年经典 / 醇厚麦香 / 美式拉格 |
| 贝克啤酒 310ml | 100%纯麦德啤 / 入口顺滑 / 经典拉格 |
| 加多宝 310ml | 正宗凉茶 / 草本配方 / 清润解腻 |
| 喜力啤酒 330ml | 全麦酿造 / 清爽微苦 / 经典绿罐 |

版式：左边品牌色卡片（红/蓝/绿按品类分）+ 右下罐子 + 右上规格角标，一律 1000×1000。文件夹里保留三套：**卖点卡片**（推荐上架用）、**纯图**（白底单罐，缩略图小的时候更清楚）、**带字**（早期红条版，可删）。

两点说明：
- 卡片上的文案是我按品类写的通用说法，不是功效承诺；想换成你店里的说法（「冰镇现开」「买二送一」）告我一句就改。
- 你菜单里还有**王老吉 310ml**，这套里没做——需要的话我照同版式补一张。
